_doc: measured-baseline.json — handover v2 artifact. Every figure is measured on this box unless marked 'reference'. Supersedes prose sheets for machine consumption; see docs/benchmarks/current-numbers-20260915.md for commentary.

box.runtime: Windows 11 native + WSL2 over /dev/dxg (no /dev/kfd, no PM4 replay)

launch.why_fit_off: shared-MTP --fit on preflight fails with 'qwen4exp requires ctx_other to be set' so the draft is unaccounted; see shared-mtp-fit-report.md

acceptance_mtp_nmax2._note: position-0 survival = P(first draft token == target argmax); see acceptance-metric-frozen-20260915.md

long_context_251k._doc: docs/benchmarks/longctx-251k-20260915.md. -c 262144, WSL down. NOTE: this -c costs ~15% shallow prefill vs the -c 32768 tables above (862 vs 1021 t/s @16k) -- do not mix.
long_context_251k._warm_warning: rep0 is COLD. At >=131k cold under-reports prefill by 20-55%. Only rep>=1 is trustworthy at depth; the original single-rep table below is superseded by long_context_251k_warm.
long_context_251k.verdict: 251k context works end to end: warm ~310 s prefill (~810 t/s), then ~26-29 t/s with MTP, no memory failure.

long_context_251k_warm._doc: Warm (rep 1) re-measure at depth. results/lc-lcwarm-prefill.json. These SUPERSEDE the cold rows above; the deep prefill decline is gentle (~1.5-2%/inch), not a cliff.

mtp_shape_ub8192_nmax2_gen256._doc: results/lc-lc-mtp-g256.json. gen 256 (~230 draft rounds/row) gives a stable acceptance; rep 1 reported. Replaces the noisy gen-64 MTP rows.
mtp_shape_ub8192_nmax2_gen256.verdict: MTP decode is essentially depth-independent at ~30-33 t/s (a +-4% band); acceptance rises from 56% at 16k to 73% at 251k.

long_context_251k_warm.rule: Never report a single rep at depth on this box; the first rep pays disk reads the OS page cache has not warmed. And use gen>=256 for acceptance (gen 64 = ~30 draft rounds = noisy).

decode_root_cause_20260916._doc: docs/benchmarks/decode-alu-bound-dp4a-20260916.md. Standalone HIP bench (shapebench.hip), 12 GB cache-proof, 150 realistic buffers, identical loads/launches/grid, only the inner loop varies.
decode_root_cause_20260916.gap: production 52-53% vs the real algorithm's in-vitro 80.8% -> ~1.5x decode available
decode_root_cause_20260916.estimate: 4.219 GB / 236.4 GB/s / 0.808 = 22.1 ms/token -> ~45 t/s serial, vs 29.9 measured (upper bound; only the IQ4_NL majority behaves like K)
decode_root_cause_20260916.remaining_suspect: multi-warp K-reduction (real mmvq uses tmp_shared + buf_iw spin-locks; the 80.8% replica used one warp per buffer, no cross-warp reduction) on ~150 small kernels/step

ilintar_strix_halo._note: ub 16384 one batch, no MTP, retained-PM4 runtime
